title: Transportation Change Form
subtitle: Capture student route, effective day, alternate stop, and request source; confirm driver notice and arrival confirmation.
description: Transportation Change records student route, effective day, alternate stop, request source, driver notice, and arrival confirmation. Transportation Change evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this transportation change operational record when staff must document student route and effective day. Reconcile alternate stop, request source, driver notice, and arrival confirmation before the transportation change handoff. Use the guardian request, identity verification, original route sheet, alternate-stop map, school approval, dispatch notice, driver acknowledgment, and arrival confirmation. This request alters one student's day-specific dismissal route using guardian authentication, alternate stop or pickup person, dispatch update, driver read-back, school release, and arrival verification. Ask the assigned transportation change reviewer to confirm student route against the organization's policy.
